{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only converted customers
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Count how many of these have valid age (not -1)
valid_age_count = (converted_df['customer_age'] != -1).sum()

# Compute mean age on valid ages
mean_age = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

# Print results
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {valid_age_count}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1 sentinels): {mean_age}")"}
